title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(School's finally out...
This day felt so long for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is it because I'm just that excited about having singing practice with Kusanagi?)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Valentine's Day is coming up!
I can't wait to share chocolates with everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Valentine's Day...
It's already that time of year.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'd like to give something to Miku and the others... But what would be best?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, actually, I think the mall's having a Valentine's Day fair. That might be a good place to look.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: What are you gonna make? I wanna try my hand at baking a chocolate tart.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
You are...?
I was thinking about being lazy and just buying some...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
If we're gonna exchange them, they should all be homemade!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: They don't absolutely have to be homemade. I mean, store-bought ones just look better and more appetizing, you know?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I get what you mean...
But homemade means that there's just that much more love baked into them, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (More love baked into them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I agree that a homemade gift would do a better job of showing someone just how much you appreciate them as opposed to a store-bought one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But what would I make...?
I don't really know how to bake sweets or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No, now's not the time for this.
I need to hurry. I shouldn't keep Kusanagi waiting!)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
H-How was that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really good.
I thought you also did well at Shibuya Festa, but you seem to just keep getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You already had such a clear, refined voice, but it's like it's become even more refined...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm guessing that you feel a lot more confident about your singing now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... S-Sorry, I didn't mean to sound uppity...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Actually, that made me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, it's hard for me to tell how my singing is changing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it means a lot coming from you, Kusanagi. I feel like I've grown quite a bit now, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At the same time, I should also be thanking you... I've learned so much by practicing with you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, you have...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Whenever I practice with you, I notice things that I don't normally...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's so nice to be able to practice singing with someone else outside of the Wonder Stage like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? Then, I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway... Wanna try singing together next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! Oh, but... I'd like to get something to drink first. All this singing has made me parched.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'd like something as well. There's a convenience store just right there, so let's head over together.
se_event_candle_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Convenience Store Clerk
rows.Line: Thank you, have a nice day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad that we were able to get some drinks, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That store...
It was covered with Valentine's Day merchandise.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There were so many different chocolates on display in front of the register too. I guess it really is just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me of some girls who I overheard talking about Valentine's today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I heard them talking, I began thinking about what I'm going to do, but couldn't really come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, are you planning on giving some gifts to people?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, my bandmates.
But I don't really know how to bake sweets or anything, so I initially thought about just buying something from the store...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But one of those girls said how it'd be more meaningful if you made a gift yourself... So, I sort of want to do that instead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
I think I'm in the same boat as you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Kusanagi, you too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I also initially thought that something store-bought would be fine... However, after rehearsal yesterday, we started talking about Valentine's Day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't Valentine's Day such a wonderhoy event?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna make some really amazing sweets, so stay tuned, everyone! I don't know what yet... But it's gonna be really awesome!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After Emu said that, I started thinking that I should also make something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like something Otori would say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I also don't really know how to bake and stuff, so I'm not sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't there a good solution out there...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... What if we made something other than sweets?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something other than sweets?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Handmade accessories or trinkets... Food's not the only way to show someone that you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True... That never came to mind for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, not being limited to sweets means we might have more options available to us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, then...
What if we tried making our gifts together, Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Together...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, it could be fun to make our gifts through some trial and error.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, of course... You don't have to if you don't want to, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh... N-No, that does sound fun.
I... I'd like to try making something with you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But what could we make?
The only things that immediately come to mind are hair accessories and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's an option. However, Saki and Honami may like that, but Shiho might not...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... We should go for something that everyone's gonna like, but that we can manage to make...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still can't think of anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami probably would've already come up with something too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Yeah...
She's really good at knitting and making accessories by hand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, I didn't know that...
Then, she probably would know what to do in this sort of situation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I might just ask her for some advice now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I thought you were gonna make something for her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am. However, as much as I want it to be a surprise, I'd rather give a gift that's as nice as it can be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... Sorry, I wish I could've come up with something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, Kusanagi, it's okay. You don't need to apologize. Anyway, I'll try sending her a message now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Umm...
<Sorry, I know this is sudden, but there's something I need to ask you. Kusanagi and I were trying to come up with something we can make for Valentine's Day...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Do you know anything that's simple and beginner friendly...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's kind of straight to the point, but I hope she understands...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, she's already replied.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<How about scented candles?
They're actually pretty easy to make and hard to mess up.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Scented candles...?
As in the ones that give off really nice aromas? You can make those yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that could be really good since anyone we give them to can get use out of them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You saved us, Honami. It's amazing how she can come up with an idea like this on the spot... Wait, huh...?! She keeps sending more...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Resin jewelry, leather goods... Wow, there's so many.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, by comparison, I feel like scented candles are going to be the easiest to make and decorate.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho would also probably like that the most, so I'd like to try making some...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...
Let's go with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, I'll send Honami a reply...
<Thanks. I think we'll go with the scented candles that you first suggested.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm...? She replied back...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I think I can teach you how to make them, so how about we all do it together?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait... Honami's going to teach us...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hang on... Hoshino, that makes sense since you're her friend, but me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's already invited you, so you should be more than welcome to join us. To put you at ease, I can ask just to be sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm kinda nervous... I haven't really had a chance to talk to Mochizuki before...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I want to get to know her better. I don't want to let this opportunity go to waste...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to join you two...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great. I'll let Honami know right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what we should make, but I'm glad I asked her for some advice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(And Honami said she'd teach us...
I need to do my best with Kusanagi to make sure our scented candles turn out well!)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, guess what?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's almost...Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It's that time of year already...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and the mall's supposed to be having a Valentine's Day fair. I might go check it out to see if they have anything cute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, why is Valentine's Day such a big deal...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! You're kidding, right?!
Valentine's Day is a huge event that involves lots of activities! Like giving chocolates to your friends!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Giving chocolates to your friends...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... Valentine's Day is all about showing appreciation for close acquaintances and the people you care about most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why you give chocolates to all your friends!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, it doesn't have to be chocolates. Anything is okay as long as it symbolizes your appreciation for whomever receives your gift♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
That's really nice. You have a whole day dedicated to giving gifts to each other.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right?! That's why it's such a great event!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I say the four of us celebrate Valentine's Day by...giving gifts to Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we should do something for them because they're always there for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I agree...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you wanna do, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know what to give, but I'll try looking for something...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you. We really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Then, don't forget to bring all your gifts on the day of!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Giving gifts to everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want Miku and the others to feel happy... And since we're doing this, I'd like to give something to Mizuki, Ena and Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But what should I get for them...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to Valentine's Day now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I wish I could do something like Mizuki and the others...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Len, did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... N-No, it's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone. Get ready for a really amazing Valentine's Day!
A few days later
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm starting to get hungry...
I should probably have something to eat...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Where did I put the instant noodles...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. Ms. Mochizuki's supposed to come over today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And she's going to be here soon. In that case, I'll wait until she arrives...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's subtle, but Ms. Mochizuki's smile always seems to fade whenever she sees so many instant noodle containers in the garbage...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I can use this time to look at some of the comments for the video we just uploaded. That shouldn't take up too much of my energy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, this banner ad...
It's for Valentine's Day...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “Chocolates for that special someone”...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, I still haven't decided what I'm going to give everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Mizuki's going to bring some homemade sweets. But I can't do anything like that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that must be Ms. Mochizuki.
I need to go let her in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Ms. Yoisaki. Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Of course. It's always nice having you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Have you already had lunch?
If not, I can make something while I prepare your other meals.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th-Thank you. I was actually just getting a little hungry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay. Then, I'll get started right way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For lunch, I'll be making stewed udon. It's been very cold lately, so I hope it'll help warm you up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm looking forward to having it.
se_event_candle_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Ms. Mochizuki's so efficient...
Everything seems second nature to her and she doesn't waste any time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Not only that, the dishes she makes are all delicious. She really is a talented cook...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She can even bake her own apple pies. If she can handle something that difficult, then Valentine's Day should be...)
se_event_candle_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can I help you? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, um... Sorry, I didn't mean to get in the way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's just... You usually go straight back up to your room, so I began wondering if there was something you wanted to ask me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's not anything serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... If you don't mind listening for a second...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A gift for Valentine's Day...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's something that came up with my group the other day, and I was thinking about what to bring.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I briefly considered homemade sweets, but I don't know how to make anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I owe them all quite a lot, so I'd like to take this opportunity to properly thank them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. And that's why you seemed preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't realize that you were also in the same predicament...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Also...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. The truth is, Ichika asked me for some advice regarding this very subject just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hoshino did...?
Is she also planning on making something?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she'd already whittled her options down to jewelry or other accessories, but I gave her a few other ideas to go along with that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Accessories? I see. Yes, that is an option...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It is. However, I believe a Valentine's Day gift can take any shape as long as it symbolizes your appreciation for the person receiving it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree with you there.
So, what did you suggest that she make?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I gave her a few suggestions, but she ended up going with scented candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Scented candles...? You can make those yourself? I'm not sure I could...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's not true. Anyone can make them as long as they have all the necessary ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, actually. Ms. Yoisaki, if you'd like...
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We arrived a little too early, but it's roundabout the time we agreed to meet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That reminds me... Mochizuki's supposed to be coming with someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think she said her name's Kanade Yoisaki... Isn't she...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's the one who helped us that time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Ichika, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hi, Honami. Hi, Kanade.
You came together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello, Hoshino. Yes, we did. And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's definitely her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, so...
You're the one who played the piano for us during our New Year's show, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
You performed in that show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. So, thank you very much for helping us out that time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay. I just thought that it'd be a shame for the show to have ended there. If anything, thank you for allowing me to participate in such a fun show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you two were already acquainted.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Actually, me neither.
This is our first time speaking to one another.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, allow me to reintroduce you two to each other.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Kusanagi, this is Kanade Yoisaki.
She's in a group that produces music and she works as the composer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Recently, I got a chance to learn a few things about songwriting from her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Songwriting? That's pretty cool...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And this is Nene Kusanagi.
She's an incredible singer who's been teaching me some tips and tricks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
You must be very talented if Hoshino is your student.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, um... I'm really not...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I just thought it was funny how they're both your teachers, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, you're right.
Kusanagi's my singing teacher and Kanade's my songwriting teacher.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you get to be a teacher and show us how to make our own candles today, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Before I forget...
Thank you very much for doing this, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Kusanagi, if you don't mind...
Why don't we try being less formal with one another since I believe we're the same age?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? O-Oh, okay...
Yeah, that would be easier.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then... Thanks for doing this, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... We're making scented candles together today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to apologize in advance. I don't really know much about them other than that they smell nice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, same...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'll begin explaining how we'll be making our candles. In truth, Ms. Yoisaki's statement mostly covers it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Scented candles are simply candles with scented oils mixed into their wax.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you light them, the wax melts and the oils release their fragrances to the surroundings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Scented oils...?
You mean the ones that smell like lavender and cypress...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. This time, we'll be using something called essential oils for the most part, which are natural oils derived from plants...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Depending on which aroma is used, a candle is supposed to help someone focus, relax or even fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? So they don't just smell nice...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A candle's flame also apparently has the ability to calm one's nerves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, between their flames and lovely fragrances, scented candles work wonders for relaxation and soothing the soul.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't know any of that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: On top of being sort of fashionable, they work as a nice present. I'm sure everyone is going to like them very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree!
Um, so... Shall we start shopping for everything we'll need?
Scent Shop

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... Here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow... Even from over here it smells really nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, I see a whole assortment of bottles on display...! These are all scented oils...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they have so many. I don't even know where to begin, let alone which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case... Why not choose the ones that you like the most or suit the person receiving your candle?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can also choose based on their various properties, which should be written on their respective labels. Once you know that and how they smell, you should have an easier time choosing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That makes sense...
Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anytime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, for now, would you all like to browse around here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to head over to the crafts shop over there to pick up something I ordered.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then... Do you want me to come with you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd rather you all take your time and have fun while picking out some oils since they have so many available.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, we'll stay here and keep browsing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, they really do have a lot of choices...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, they do...
Rosemary, bergamot, clary sage, eucalyptus... They even have some blended oils.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm honestly having trouble thinking about how some of these will actually smell.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too... But they have a few samples here. Why don't we try seeing what they smell like...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, this citrusy aroma's nice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: According to the label, this is sweet orange. There's even an explanation.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Apparently, its sweet aroma helps you clear your head and feel refreshed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see... This scent...
It reminds me of Saki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Saki...? Oh, Tsukasa's younger sister?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Oh, actually... That makes sense since Saki has this way of cheering up everybody around her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cheering everybody up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It sort of also suits those two.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, which scent is that one?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, lavender. It also has a nice sweet aroma.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lavender? That seems like a pretty common one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, its label even says that it's the most popular scent and how it played an important role in the development of aromatherapy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not very familiar with its history, but this gentle, flowery fragrance is so soothing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of all these scented oils, lavender in particular seems to be the most effective for relaxing oneself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, in that case... I think I'll buy some. I'd like something that will help everyone relax.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
It's not just about what suits who... We also have to think about how we want them to feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good point. Then, why don't we keep browsing since they have so many available here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kusanagi, try this one.
It's supposed to smell like grapefruits.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh wow... That's such a refreshing smell... It's like there's a pile of grapefruits right in front of me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade, can you guess what this one smells like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It smells sweet... And fruity... Apples?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought so too at first!
Apparently, it's chamomile, but it really does smell sweet and gentle like the way apples do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Um... Are you looking for something in particular, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, so... I liked the lavender we sampled just now, so I was hoping to find some others that are also just as soothing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Soothing...
I think that shelf over there had more oils like that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes. Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you like to see some together...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Y-You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I need a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They had so many more different aromas than I was expecting. Just looking through all of them was fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but I started getting a little lost as to what actually smells good or nice after smelling so many.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too... However, I think we all found a few that we liked, so let's go back once we've taken a little break.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Look at that display over there... Aren't those scented candles?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... I didn't know that they also sold the finished product here. They're beautiful, and so colorful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow. This one looks like it has a flower inside it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I believe that's a hydrangea. It's so vivid and pretty...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks like they have several with different species of flowers in them. Oh, this one even has an orange and other fruits in it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It does. That's really cute...
The others would probably be so startled if I made something like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But that looks really difficult...
I'm not very good at making these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it does look difficult... B-But we should be fine since we have Honami as our teacher! So, let's give it our best shot...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, you're right.
Ah, have you all been resting at this bench?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami! Did they have what you ordered?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I apologize for making you all wait. So, how did things go?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I found some that should suit Saki and the others. But we decided to take a quick break after being exposed to so many different aromas...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Oh, did you all happen to bring the bottles too close to your noses...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Scented oils are very concentrated, so it's better to waft instead of sniff... I'm sorry. I should've mentioned this sooner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that's okay... I feel much better after taking a break. How about you two?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel much better now too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness... Then, why don't we all go back in together? I should be able to give advice if you feel you need it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you all found some that you liked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. All that's left is to actually make our candles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll do just fine.
I promise to do my best to teach you all what I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The plan's to make them at my house, yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. But, um... I'm really sorry to intrude since you just had me over at your house the other day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um... M-Me too...
Especially since we really only met a second ago... I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay. I joined in at the last minute, so the least I could do is provide the space for us to make our candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, my house was a mess before, but Ms. Mochizuki's done a wonderful job of cleaning it up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... I-It's nothing. Anyway, it's fine, so don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for being so generous, Ms. Yoisaki. We'll try not to be too much of a bother.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, shall we?
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for having us over.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please, come in. It's not very spacious, but feel free to move the furniture around and sit wherever you like.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll pour us some tea.
Let's see... Where did I put the tea bags we bought the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Yoisaki, that's okay. I don't mind doing it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, you're not here to work today, so please make yourself at home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... I need to boil some water first... I'll fill the kettle with some water and... Hnng... I-It's so heavy...
se_event_candle_2023_007
se_event_candle_2023_007

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-Is everything okay, Ms. Yoisaki?
Are you sure you don't want me to help?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-Sorry... Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ahh... Thank you for the tea, Honami, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um... It was delicious.
Thank you for making that for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness... I'm glad it actually turned out well... I couldn't have done it without your help, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Although, I was really hoping to make some for you all by myself... Thank you, and I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you don't need to thank me. If anything, I really appreciate the gesture.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to relax a little, shall we start making our scented candles...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay. Again, thank you for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not to worry. Scented candles are very easy to make. All we have to do is melt down some store-bought candles, mix in the oils we bought earlier and reharden them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just melt and reharden them...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It does seem a lot easier when you put it that way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I felt the same way when I first learned how to do this. Regardless, let's just take it one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, you'll each need to choose some crayons to give your candles color.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Crayons will give them their color...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you shave off bits of crayons and mix them into the wax. You won't believe how beautifully this works.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I recommend choosing colors that go with the fragrances you chose or even using multiple to create several layers of colors.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Several layers...?
You can do that...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Of course, you don't have to choose any colors at all... However, since we're doing this, I thought it'd be nice if we all did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Once you've chosen a color, we'll use a double boiler to melt down the wax. I'll start us off...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, we'll need three large pots and bowls... You heat the bowls with boiling water and use them to melt the wax.
se_event_candle_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It seems kinda strange to melt candles for their wax...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... But this process is sort of similar to how you make your own chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The wax is starting to melt...
Wait, what's this...? It looks like a piece of string...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah, that's the wick.
We'll save that as we'll be using it later...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now we just need to wait a little longer for the candles to melt.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, they seem ready.
Next, we'll start mixing in the crayons you've all chosen. Why don't we do this part together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Wait... How much do we need to put in...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm... Not a lot.
If you put in too much, it may cause the wick to not light because it isn't able to absorb the wax properly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, don't worry!
I'll be right here to make sure you don't put in too much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay. That's a relief... I think...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So... Carefully put some crayon shavings in... Little by little...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Honami, is this enough...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you don't have to be so careful... You can put a little more in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...? Then... H-How's this...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, good...! That should be plenty, Ichika. Now, just mix the wax and... Oh, see. It's changing colors already.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-It is...
That's incredible. It changed completely...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... Does mine look okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Yoisaki, Kusanagi, you're both doing a wonderful job...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you... That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, next... We need our wax to cool off a bit. Our oil will evaporate and lose its scent if we put it in when it's still hot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? So, we're taking a short break?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but it shouldn't take too long. In the meantime, why don't we choose which fragrances we're going to mix in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... They seem to be at about the right temperature...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, everyone, please take your bowls and put in roughly ten drops of your scented oil.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay... Ten drops...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope I don't lose count...
Or make it come out all at once...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-I'm sure you'll be fine.
It's meant to add a nice scent to your candle, so adding a little more than suggested shouldn't be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, if you put in too much oil, the wick will have trouble lighting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Uh, but... You don't have to be super precise either...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll reheat our wax again a little and mix it up... Also, everyone, do you have your molds ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, here's mine.
Um... We place the wick in the middle, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. The wick will go there and you'll keep it in place using a pair of chopsticks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After that, you'll pour in your wax.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. I'll give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, Ichika, here's your bowl...
Be careful not to spill any, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Gently carry my bowl over and... Oh...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Wow, that's really nice...
It's already starting to smell like oranges...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(It's even turned bright orange.
This candle might actually turn out really well.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope Saki likes my present to her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Okay, now...
Carefully pour the wax in...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Nicely done, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks! So, what's next...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Next...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Nene & Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All that's left is to wait for the wax to reharden. The final step of the process was to pour it into the molds.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See? Wasn't it easy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I was under the impression that there were more steps, but I guess that's it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't think it would be this easy either...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It should only get easier once you've gotten a hang of this process. So this time, why don't you try melting the wax yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And please feel free to ask for help if you get stuck. I'll be there with you every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What color should I make my next one...?)

rows.Line: (The one I made for Saki has a cheerful color and fragrance to it... Shiho's is next, so maybe something more subdued would work best.)

rows.Line:
(As for Honami... Hmm...
I could just ask her what she'd like since she's right here... But I'd rather give one to her without doing that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that she'll enjoy it more if I keep it a surprise.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. We can also make ones with flowers in them once you think you've gotten the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You bought some dried flowers earlier...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they're called botanical candles. And there's no need to worry since they're also fairly easy to make.

rows.Line: First, once we have finished scented candles like the ones we just made, we'll place them in a slightly larger mold.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That adds some space in between the candle and the mold, which you can fill with whatever flowers you like. After that, you'll pour in more wax...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it'll be done once it hardens.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, is that how they made all those pretty candles at the store...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It definitely seems much more doable after hearing how you can make them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It sounds a little more difficult to make compared to a regular scented candle, but I'd like to give it a try...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, while I'm at it, I should make candles with flowers that represent Saki, Shiho, Honami, Miku and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Saki would be... Mimosas...?
Statices could work for Shiho since they have this quiet and kind feel to them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What should I do for Honami, Miku and the others...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You seem to be really enjoying this, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you seemed very happy just now. May I ask what you were thinking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was thinking about everyone who'd be receiving my candles, as well as which colors and flowers would suit them best...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I've been thinking about that too. I've been trying to figure out which colors and fragrances would match them best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...
I can't really make them like the ones they had in the store, but I'd like to make candles that put smiles on all their faces.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You two were thinking about the same thing...? Is it normal for people to give their gifts this much thought when they're making them by hand...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I wouldn't be surprised.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Honami always brings snacks and treats for us during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means she's probably thinking about us when making them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Honami...
I'm really glad that I decided to make these myself today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean... You've helped me understand how wonderful and important it is to think about who'll be receiving a gift while making it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I finally understand how much thought goes into anything that's homemade.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, Honami, thank you...
I really appreciate you being our teacher today and everything you've made for us up until this point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, um...! I always appreciate it when you do make something for us! It's just... Making something myself like this has given me a better understanding of what goes through your mind...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Imagining is one thing, but you really can gain a lot when you learn by doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, the wax has already hardened...
These are the last ones we made, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... That's all of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone! I was very impressed towards the end since you all were able to make them on your own...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, Ms. Mochizuki, we couldn't have done this without you. Thank you very much for teaching us how to make these...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um... It's nothing serious, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's just...
We didn't make any candles for each other.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I didn't make any for you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, while we're here, I'd like to make some scented candles for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we finish by each making one last candle...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just one?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since making some for all of us right now would be very difficult...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Instead, let's each make one and pass them around as gifts to one another. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...! Nice idea. I'd like to try that. Kusanagi, Kanade, what do you two think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's keep making more scented candles for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They all seem to have hardened...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I just checked by touching mine... I think they're ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's remove them from the molds... Okay, they seem good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... How do you want to gift these to each other? Should we wrap them first?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We don't have enough bags for the people here...
So, how about we just give them to each other as is...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That seems a little odd if I'm going to be honest, but I guess we don't have much of a choice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I actually like that idea.
You don't get many opportunities to give someone a gift right after you finish making it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: True. Then, um... Mine will go to you, Hoshino. You'll give yours to Yoisaki, and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll give mine to Ms. Mochizuki, and she'll give hers to you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... I know it's a little early, but Happy Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here you are, Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! Oh, it already smells really nice. I'd like to light it as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy Valentine's Day, Ms. Mochizuki.
I really appreciate all the cleaning and cooking you do. I've been able to live with more ease thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
I also really enjoy working at your house, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Exchanging gifts like this is making me feel all warm and fuzzy inside...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
And as much as I want this to last, I'm really looking forward to using it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, then... Why don't we light it now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, now? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I see no problem with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, Kusanagi, could I try lighting the candle you gave me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I hope it works...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, let's light it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, wait.
It'll look prettier if it's dark, so I'll turn off the lights.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, here we go...

rows.Line: I like how the little flame gently dances in the darkness...

rows.Line: Yeah, I'm starting to see why looking at them can help you relax...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And this fragrance... It's so soothing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it is. It's gentle like...lavender...?

rows.Line: (There's no way for me to tell what Kusanagi was thinking when she chose this fragrance, but...)

These chocolates are shaped like musical instruments.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I bought them at the mall during their Valentine's Day fair.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're so cute that I sort of don't want to eat them. Oh, Honami, did you also bring something for us?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I made some chocolate fondant.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's going to be difficult to eat it as is, so I'll cut it into smaller pieces later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, it seems like you also brought something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like for you to all have these...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, did you make something for each of us? I wonder what's inside...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Are these candles...?
They smell very nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, they're scented candles.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Interesting. I wasn't expecting you to bring scented candles, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And the way they've been wrapped... Did you make them yourself?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, she's right! Ichi, when did you...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just the other day. Honami taught me how to make them... I chose colors and fragrances that I thought suited all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's amazing...! Like really amazing! Thank you so much, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah... Thanks, Ichika.
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
Also, Honami, thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. All I did was teach you how to make them. You put in the effort to make these for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I was able to make these because of you... And I'm so glad that they like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There's actually one more present...
I made it with all of you in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All of us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. This one's also a scented candle... And here it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, it's bigger than the others! And it has flowers in it! Did you embed them into the wax somehow?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I kept you all in mind when choosing these flowers, so I hope you get a chance to use it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, can we light them now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna see what they smell like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but isn't it a bit too soon? Won't it be better to use them to relax after we're done practicing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho's right...
B-But I still really wanna light them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to really love what you made for them, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they do... Ichika worked very hard on them, and I'm sure they can tell...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think so too...
Thank you for these, Ichika. We promise to treasure them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Y-You're welcome...!

rows.Line: (All the fun I had making scented candles with Kusanagi, Kanade and Honami...)
